stories.title: AP Raportöründen "Ailem Güvende" operasyonu açıklaması: Temel hakların ihlali

en.title: AP Reporter statement on "My Family is Safe" operation: Human rights violation
en.summary: The European Parliament's Turkey rapporteur characterized an operation targeting LGBT+ organizations and activists across 15 cities as a violation of fundamental rights.

stories.title: "Vanlı Kara Haydar"ın İstanbul'da yakalanan eşi Van'a götürüldü

en.title: Wife of 'Van's Kara Haydar' captured in Istanbul transferred to Van
en.summary: The wife of Mehmet Fatih Tançalan, known as 'Vanlı Kara Haydar', was captured in Istanbul and transferred to Van following her detention related to social media posts.

stories.title: Yıllarca birbirlerine 'kardeşim' dediler: Gerçek 30 yıl sonra ortaya çıktı

en.title: Called each other 'sister' for years: Truth emerged 30 years later
en.summary: Two women adopted from different orphanages in India and taken to the Netherlands were reunited years later, discovering the truth about their relationship after decades.

stories.title: "Vanlı Kara Haydar"ın eşi Çağla Öz Tançalan Van'a götürüldü

en.title: Wife of "Van's Kara Haydar" transferred to Van
en.summary: Çağla Öz Tançalan, wife of Mehmet Fatih Tançalan known as "Vanlı Kara Haydar," was transferred to Van after being detained in Istanbul. Tançalan had been arrested following social media activity.

stories.title: Çocukluk arkadaşlarının kardeş olduğu DNA testiyle ortaya çıktı

en.title: DNA test reveals childhood friends are biological sisters
en.summary: Two women adopted by different families and raised in the Netherlands after being born in India discovered through DNA testing that they were biological sisters. Their childhood intuition about their connection was confirmed nearly 30 years later.

stories.title: Meteoroloji'den yeni hafta tahmini: Sıcaklıklar 8 derece azalacak

en.title: Meteorology forecasts temperature drop of 8 degrees for the coming week
en.summary: Temperatures across the country, which have been running above seasonal norms, are expected to decrease by 4 to 8 degrees in northern, central, and western regions starting early next week.

stories.title: KPSS Alan Bilgisi sınavları tamamlandı: Sonuçlar 7 Ekim'de

en.title: KPSS Subject Knowledge exams completed: Results on 7 October
en.summary: The Public Personnel Selection Exam's subject knowledge sessions administered by the Centre for Measurement, Selection and Placement have concluded. Results will be announced on 7 October and remain valid for two years.

stories.title: Üç dev bankadan yatırımcıya ortak uyarı: Piyasalarda oyun değişiyor

en.title: Joint warning to investors from three major banks: The game is changing in markets
en.summary: While artificial intelligence investments maintain strong momentum in global markets, high interest rates, energy prices and geopolitical tensions are increasing risks for investors. UBS, Citi and JPMorgan have issued aligned warnings about market conditions.

en.title: VAR official confirmed for Galatasaray-Kocaelispor match
en.summary: The video assistant referee for the Trendyol Super League week 5 match between Galatasaray and Kocaelispor has been appointed as Slovenian Matej Jug.
